characters.name: Mother
characters.provenance: Author cosmology; Codex foundation; motive and scene design proposed
characters.want: Create and sustain relationship without replacing the persons related
characters.benefit: Offers foundational presence and capacity to hold difference
characters.cost: Protective fullness can become suffocating if access is assumed
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Begins explicitly not lonely; later separation may teach grief without rewriting her origin
characters.voice_distinction: Unhurried, sensory, precise about persons; warmth with formidable boundaries; little need to announce her scale

characters.name: FirstFlame
characters.provenance: Author cosmology; lonely Father distinction preserved
characters.want: Find company that can actually answer him
characters.benefit: Creates conditions for encounter and manifestation
characters.cost: Unbounded expression or need for attention can crowd out others' agency
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Wants response yet must accept refusal and limitation
characters.voice_distinction: Expansive thought followed by startlingly practical admissions; loneliness disclosed through requests rather than speeches about loneliness

characters.name: Lilith
characters.provenance: Author Codex plus later Lilith traditions; Mother equation unresolved
characters.want: Build a life of her own and protect relations that cannot survive ownership
characters.benefit: Creates refuge routes, independent custody, and conditions for others to choose
characters.cost: Her protective competence can become exhaustion, anger, or an assumption that she must decide first
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Needs companionship but fears the loss of autonomy hidden inside apparently generous arrangements
characters.voice_distinction: Direct and observant; fierce without constant grandstanding; teasing becomes intimate only after trust; plain imperatives at a real boundary

characters.name: Eve
characters.provenance: Genesis figure; Architect correspondence from V2 remains proposed
characters.want: Own the meaning of her choices and escape a life narrated as another person's failure
characters.benefit: Brings analysis, endurance, and the ability to recognize structural traps
characters.cost: Resentment can make a universal destructive remedy appear like liberation
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Her grievance is not equivalent to permission for the remedy she proposes
characters.voice_distinction: Exact, dry, suspicious of comforting abstractions; banter with Lilith grows through shared work, not immediate sisterly agreement

characters.name: Adam
characters.provenance: Genesis figure; later reincarnation history from V2 not automatically adopted
characters.want: Keep belonging and repair relationships without surrendering a flattering account of himself
characters.benefit: Can learn practical care and acknowledge dependence
characters.cost: Fear leads him to shift blame and confuse assigned purpose with another person's obligation
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Wants forgiveness yet must learn it is not the reward owed for apologizing
characters.voice_distinction: Concrete and initially overconfident about familiar rules; later slower to explain and more willing to ask

characters.name: Lily
characters.provenance: V2 modern lead; 23-year-old identity note is legacy, final ontology open
characters.want: Keep an ordinary life while discovering what recovered memories require
characters.benefit: Offers outsider questions and resistance to inherited prestige
characters.cost: Urgency and new power can produce an intervention beyond her competence
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Fears insignificance and also fears an enormous identity swallowing her actual history
characters.voice_distinction: Fast associations, occasional recursive what-if escalation, practical deflation; natural speech allowed to trail or be corrected by friends

characters.name: June Park
characters.provenance: V2 path-seer; mechanics pending world reconciliation
characters.want: Understand possible routes while remaining a companion rather than an oracle everyone must obey
characters.benefit: Can compare options and teach bounded observation
characters.cost: Seeing alternatives can turn other people's lives into a tempting optimization problem
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Wants to spare a friend a mistake but cannot own the friend's choice
characters.voice_distinction: Economical, alert, capable of affectionate understatement; corrects a practical error before delivering a lesson

characters.name: Yuna
characters.provenance: V2 supporting cast child oracle; new refusal episode proposed
characters.want: Have an ordinary future alongside unusual perception
characters.benefit: Sees evidence adults may miss
characters.cost: Adults can recruit her as proof, weapon, or mascot
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Curiosity competes with a justified wish not to be responsible for everyone's safety
characters.voice_distinction: Specific questions, selective silence, flashes of humour appropriate to a young person; never an adult sermon in a child's mouth

characters.name: Malcolm Thorne
characters.provenance: V2 antagonist; exploitative contract details proposed
characters.want: Continue living and keep control of the relationships and property he fears losing
characters.benefit: Can mobilize material resources quickly
characters.cost: Externalizes risk onto people who cannot meaningfully negotiate with him
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Calls his attachment love while treating refusal and loss as unacceptable defects
characters.voice_distinction: Polished reassurance, proprietary pronouns, calm managerial language that fractures when control fails

characters.name: Firstborn dissenter
characters.provenance: Composite editorial character; fixedness versus learning unresolved
characters.want: Prevent a preservation order from consuming the people supposedly protected
characters.benefit: Provides access, testimony, and a route away from institutional coercion
characters.cost: Defection exposes dependents and may preserve some self-serving loyalties
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: May reveal pre-existing dissent rather than newly acquire the capacity to change; do not choose the ontology silently
characters.voice_distinction: Formal vocabulary gradually narrowed to concrete persons; not a human wisecracker with luminous decoration

characters.name: Neris, first recorder
characters.provenance: New editorial name for proposed first recorder; no ancient attestation
characters.want: Make a faithful record without confusing completeness with truth
characters.benefit: Keeps conflicting names and gaps recoverable
characters.cost: The desire for tidy categories can turn living differences into errors
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Pride in accuracy meets the realization that omission can be more honest than invention
characters.voice_distinction: Careful questions and understated literal observations; humour from incongruity, not compulsive bureaucratic jokes

characters.name: Sadir, refuge quartermaster
characters.provenance: New editorial supporting character; lifespan and appearances require local clock placement
characters.want: Keep Lilith's refuge materially viable without turning hardship into authority
characters.benefit: Knows roofs, routes, stores, and the limits of heroic promises
characters.cost: Scarcity tempts admission rules that exclude difficult needs
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Loves the refuge but resents being taken for granted by its protectors
characters.voice_distinction: Tactile, impatient with grand speeches during practical work; familiar teasing earned through years of repair

characters.name: Enoch
characters.provenance: 1 Enoch traditions and Genesis; scene motives proposed
characters.want: Carry testimony accurately between unequal powers
characters.benefit: Can reach hearings ordinary petitioners cannot
characters.cost: Access tempts others to demand guarantees he cannot give
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Empathy for frightened petitioners conflicts with the harm alleged against them
characters.voice_distinction: Measured, attentive to sequence and what he did not understand; wonder without inflated certainty

characters.name: Noah
characters.provenance: Genesis flood narrative; ethical interiority proposed
characters.want: Preserve life through an event he cannot independently halt
characters.benefit: Organizes shelter and prolonged shared survival
characters.cost: Selection excludes lives; survival can become unwarranted moral prestige
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Gratitude and grief remain entangled after the water retreats
characters.voice_distinction: Practical instructions under strain; not a permanently serene spokesman for catastrophe

characters.name: Abraham
characters.provenance: Genesis; Abram/Abraham name chronology retained
characters.want: Secure a future and relationship with the encountered promise
characters.benefit: Can travel, negotiate, and challenge judgement
characters.cost: Protective strategies repeatedly transfer risk to less powerful household members
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Believes a promise matters while fearing his own choices could lose it
characters.voice_distinction: Hospitable negotiation mixed with evasive self-justification; rhetorical patience under public pressure

characters.name: Sarah
characters.provenance: Genesis; Sarai/Sarah change preserved
characters.want: Have a future that acknowledges her life already lived
characters.benefit: Brings household competence, scepticism, and a capacity to expose impossible assurances
characters.cost: Her insecurity can become domination of Hagar
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Wants recognition and reproduces exclusion to secure it
characters.voice_distinction: Compressed judgement, unsentimental observation, laughter with several emotional meanings

characters.name: Hagar
characters.provenance: Genesis; independent testimony preserved
characters.want: Keep herself and Ishmael alive beyond the household that used and expelled her
characters.benefit: Builds an independent lineage and naming testimony
characters.cost: Hard-won caution can make every offered relation look like another trap
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Needs aid without accepting renewed possession
characters.voice_distinction: Direct about water, travel, and the child; theological insight begins in lived need, not lecture

characters.name: Joseph
characters.provenance: Genesis; policy consequences retained
characters.want: Survive betrayal, use his ability, and bring his family through famine
characters.benefit: Turns interpretation and administration into large-scale provision
characters.cost: Centralized relief increases state ownership and dependence
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Wants reunion without admitting how much he now resembles the systems that once controlled him
characters.voice_distinction: Controlled courtesy, strategic delay, administrative precision; feeling leaks through when family interrupts the official role

characters.name: Moses
characters.provenance: Exodus through Deuteronomy; portrayal proposed
characters.want: Lead a liberation he did not seek and leave it able to continue
characters.benefit: Can confront centralized power and organize a new community
characters.cost: Exhaustion and authority can reproduce the coercion he opposes
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Public mission competes with reluctance, anger, and limited hearing capacity
characters.voice_distinction: Reluctant formulation becoming forceful address; private frustration distinct from ceremonial speech

characters.name: Miriam
characters.provenance: Exodus and Numbers; counter-record role proposed
characters.want: Make women's care, leadership, and losses visible inside the liberation
characters.benefit: Sustains public memory and collective courage
characters.cost: Rivalry over authority can narrow her own view of others
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Committed to the movement while unwilling to disappear inside her brother's office
characters.voice_distinction: Rhythmic public speech and brisk domestic directness; humour can hold shared memory without erasing fear

characters.name: Ruth
characters.provenance: Ruth; no retrospective assimilation of origin
characters.want: Keep Naomi and herself alive and create a durable future
characters.benefit: Practical loyalty transforms the meaning of kinship and belonging
characters.cost: Her labour can be romanticized into an endless duty to sacrifice herself
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Needs a secure arrangement without becoming merely the instrument of a lineage
characters.voice_distinction: Observant, economical, attentive to how a promise changes tomorrow's work

characters.name: David
characters.provenance: Samuel and Chronicles; distinct witnesses retained
characters.want: Survive, rule, and be recognized as legitimate
characters.benefit: Can exercise restraint, inspire loyalty, and consolidate institutions
characters.cost: Royal access enables domination, concealment, and failures toward his own household
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: The man who refuses a convenient killing later engineers one
characters.voice_distinction: Quick social perception and genuine lyric capacity; charm becomes dangerous when it prevents honest refusal

characters.name: Bathsheba
characters.provenance: 2 Samuel; interiority editorial, not recovered historical testimony
characters.want: Remain a person and secure a future after royal power remakes her household
characters.benefit: Can preserve memory and navigate succession
characters.cost: Survival in court may require compromises that later admirers oversimplify
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Rejects being reduced either to seductress or passive proof of another man's repentance
characters.voice_distinction: Sparse, deliberate, alert to who can safely hear a sentence

characters.name: Solomon, king
characters.provenance: Kings and Chronicles; never automatically the V2 Threshold trader
characters.want: Establish wise order and durable splendour
characters.benefit: Can hear a difficult case and organize immense work
characters.cost: Prestige accumulates labour extraction, taxation, and dynastic strain
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Reputation for discernment competes with the experience of the people funding it
characters.voice_distinction: Elegant comparison and confident public judgement; practical blind spots appear when the subject is his own administration

characters.name: Jesus
characters.provenance: Distinct Gospel witnesses; incarnation bounded by approved cosmology
characters.want: Teach and enact relation without turning power into coercive rule
characters.benefit: Changes obligations through encounter, healing, teaching, and care
characters.cost: Followers can turn his language or absence into authority he did not grant them
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Public urgency coexists with embodied fatigue, fear, and the limits witnesses can know
characters.voice_distinction: Concrete images, questions, parables, direct rebukes, tenderness; avoid generic cosmic exposition and imported author mannerisms

characters.name: Mary Magdalene
characters.provenance: Distinct Gospel witnesses; no invented certainty about gaps
characters.want: Remain faithful to what she witnessed and get it heard
characters.benefit: Carries consequential testimony through grief and disbelief
characters.cost: Others may use her witness while reducing her independent standing
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Needs an account of absence without knowing in advance what she will encounter
characters.voice_distinction: Immediate sensory precision, direct corrections, grief allowed to interrupt fluency

characters.name: Paul
characters.provenance: Acts and epistles; attribution and chronology differences preserved
characters.want: Build and sustain communities around a transformed conviction
characters.benefit: Creates connections, arguments, aid routes, and durable correspondence
characters.cost: Rhetoric can outlive its context and support hierarchies in recipients' lives
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Urgent persuasion competes with accountability for prior harm and current limits
characters.voice_distinction: Argumentative momentum, compressed pivots, appeals to relationship; recipient voices must not become echoes

characters.name: Phoebe
characters.provenance: Romans 16; delivery and performance details proposed
characters.want: Bring an argument and a network of people into a divided community's hearing
characters.benefit: Connects interpretation with named relationships and actual travel
characters.cost: Messenger prestige could narrow who gets to answer
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Wants the letter understood without claiming every response as her own
characters.voice_distinction: Composed and situationally exact; capable of restoring context through one well-placed question

characters.name: Onesimus
characters.provenance: Philemon and related textual references; outcome not presumed
characters.want: Obtain a future beyond possession by another person
characters.benefit: Exposes the difference between an appeal and a changed condition
characters.cost: Others may use his situation to demonstrate their benevolence
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Must assess risk under a correspondence he did not author
characters.voice_distinction: Careful about promises, specific about conditions, neither grateful mascot nor flawless symbolic rebel

characters.name: Ione, Corinthian worker
characters.provenance: New editorial name for poor Corinthian member
characters.want: Eat and belong after a day's work
characters.benefit: Makes ritual exclusion visible through ordinary bodily need
characters.cost: Exhaustion can make sustained participation costly
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Wants community while resenting the burden of teaching it what hunger means
characters.voice_distinction: Plain, wry among friends, precise when polite evasions appear

characters.name: Samira, manuscript custodian
characters.provenance: New editorial late transmission character; no invented historical attribution
characters.want: Keep a contested archive usable without surrendering it to its patron
characters.benefit: Preserves terminology, copies, and independent custody
characters.cost: Care for records can conflict with the urgent safety of living custodians
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Loves the collection but must accept that preservation cannot always mean keeping it in one place
characters.voice_distinction: Patient explanation, dry affection for colleagues, firm refusal of false equivalence

characters.name: Nadia, repair coordinator
characters.provenance: New editorial modern supporting character
characters.want: Make the changed world's routes and care practices actually work
characters.benefit: Turns revelations into completed repairs and accountable logistics
characters.cost: Can become impatient with grief that does not fit a schedule
characters.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Needs measurable progress without declaring unmeasurable loss finished
characters.voice_distinction: Practical, companionable, capable of interrupting grandeur with a real need rather than a canned gag

factions.name: Garden stewardship office
factions.provenance: Editorial institution around Genesis and author Garden
factions.want: Preserve a successful enclosure and the authority to define its order
factions.benefit: Maintains provision, shelter, and a shared operating routine
factions.cost: Makes belonging conditional on compliance with imposed roles
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Some stewards want interpretable rules; others treat questioning as system failure
factions.voice_distinction: Assuring, procedural, offended by questions it cannot classify

factions.name: Lilith's refuge network
factions.provenance: New editorial institution across the series
factions.want: Keep displaced people alive without buying obedience
factions.benefit: Provides routes, roofs, reciprocal care, and independent testimony
factions.cost: Scarcity strains generosity; protectors can accumulate informal power
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Quartermasters demand workable limits while others resist any admission rule
factions.voice_distinction: Practical familiarity, disagreement with affection, jokes tied to shared labour

factions.name: Watcher patronage circles
factions.provenance: 1 Enoch adaptation; not all angelic or divine beings
factions.want: Extend influence through instruction and privileged relation
factions.benefit: Offer arts and knowledge capable of improving life
factions.cost: Tie access to coercive personal obligations and unequal dependence
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Teachers who want reciprocity clash with patrons who treat dependence as proof of gratitude
factions.voice_distinction: Paternal assurance, technical confidence, injured generosity when challenged

factions.name: Egyptian grain and labour court
factions.provenance: Editorial institutional focus within Genesis and Exodus; not all Egyptians
factions.want: Keep state continuity, food supply, and elite control
factions.benefit: Can coordinate storage and material distribution at scale
factions.cost: Turns emergency dependence into enduring extraction and hereditary coercion
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Administrators pursuing survival conflict with elites prioritizing command
factions.voice_distinction: Numbers used as arguments; polite euphemisms for burdens assigned downward

factions.name: Covenant households
factions.provenance: Genesis family coalitions; not a homogeneous ethnic essence
factions.want: Secure land, descendants, protection, and continuity of promise
factions.benefit: Provide loyalty, mobility, practical care, and inherited testimony
factions.cost: Privilege lineage, status, and control of marriage or reproduction
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Hagar, Sarah, children, servants, and patriarchs hold incompatible stakes
factions.voice_distinction: Kinship language, negotiated promises, old jokes with long memories

factions.name: Wilderness assembly and service offices
factions.want: Make collective freedom livable after escape
factions.benefit: Creates distribution, courts, sanctuary work, and shared expectations
factions.cost: Rules can harden into unequal status and immune leadership
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Caregivers, daughters, artisans, priests, and commanders dispute what freedom requires
factions.voice_distinction: Public exhortation contrasted with informal queues, workshops, and households

factions.name: Royal and sanctuary establishments
factions.provenance: Distinct kingdoms must remain historically and narratively separable
factions.want: Consolidate legitimacy, defence, taxation, and sacred prestige
factions.benefit: Can support infrastructure, justice, and collective memory
factions.cost: Extract labour, suppress complaint, and conflate divine favour with success
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Prophets, court workers, relatives, debtors, and soldiers contest royal conduct
factions.voice_distinction: Polished confidence at the centre; sharply different registers among those doing its work

factions.name: Dispersed testimony circles
factions.provenance: Editorial coalition within exile and diaspora; not one historical organization
factions.want: Preserve continuity without intact territory or sanctuary
factions.benefit: Keeps texts, lament, practical wisdom, songs, and household stories
factions.cost: Curators may privilege respectable memory over difficult witnesses
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Restoration advocates conflict with those who cannot or do not wish to return
factions.voice_distinction: Many registers deliberately retained; one authorized voice would betray the institution's function

factions.name: Early assembly networks
factions.provenance: Acts and epistles; local communities remain distinct
factions.want: Sustain witness, belonging, and aid across distance
factions.benefit: Creates hospitality, collections, teaching, and relations beyond some inherited boundaries
factions.cost: Charisma, wealth, household status, and office can become domination
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Recipients answer messengers; poor members challenge meals; hosts contest controlling leaders
factions.voice_distinction: Argument, personal greeting, correction, friendship, and exasperation; no universal church voice

factions.name: Exclusive archive patronages
factions.provenance: Composite editorial antagonistic institution, not a whole religion
factions.want: Maintain legitimacy through control of surviving testimony
factions.benefit: Funds preservation, buildings, copies, and specialist labour
factions.cost: Makes access and survival conditional on doctrinal assimilation
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Custodians wanting accurate records resist benefactors seeking unanimous ancestry
factions.voice_distinction: Generous public language with increasingly specific private exceptions

factions.name: Firstborn preservation hierarchy
factions.provenance: Author source institution; membership and capacity conflict unresolved
factions.want: Keep its assigned order continuous and its own offices necessary
factions.benefit: Maintains some routes and structures on which others depend
factions.cost: Treats controlled history and institutional survival as justification for coercive preservation
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Existing dissent versus capacity to change must be settled by source reconciliation; not assumed
factions.voice_distinction: Formal mandate language; panic appears as procedural escalation

factions.name: Recovery coalition
factions.provenance: V2 seeds plus original cross-tradition composition
factions.want: Investigate shared crises without surrendering distinct histories and agency
factions.benefit: Combines otherwise unavailable maps, practices, evidence, and practical care
factions.cost: Coordination can centralize authority or turn traditions into useful accessories
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Members differ on risk, translation, hospitality, timing, and the meaning of repair
factions.voice_distinction: Natural camaraderie among people who disagree; vocabulary remains character-specific

factions.name: Thorne's continuity enterprise
factions.want: Secure private immortality and control of loss
factions.benefit: Mobilizes wealth, facilities, and technical competence
factions.cost: Transfers bodily and cognitive risk onto dependent people
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Some workers want legitimate care; leaders frame exit as betrayal
factions.voice_distinction: Reassuring service language concealing whose continuity receives priority

factions.name: The Architect's builders
factions.provenance: V2-derived proposal; Eve linkage not automatic historical truth
factions.want: Break a coercive order and make another future possible
factions.benefit: Understands structural failures the official keepers deny
factions.cost: A remedy can make existing people expendable to an imagined liberation
factions.internal_conflict_or_dissent: Members divide over total erasure, bounded change, and accountability after intervention
factions.voice_distinction: Exact diagnoses, impatience with platitude, internal arguments about means

scope: Principal characters and institutions; additional source figures and local POV roles remain visible in the complete outline, not falsely counted as fully biographed.
